label: Key Generation
subgoals: Pick e coprime to phi(n), e.g. e = 3 for phi = 40
Invert d = e^-1 mod phi(n), e.g. d = 27

label: Encryption
subgoals: Encode the message as integer m < n
Raise c = m^e mod n, e.g. 7^3 = 13 mod 55

label: Decryption
subgoals: Raise m = c^d mod n, e.g. 13^27 = 7 mod 55
Expand ed = 1 + k*phi(n) for the Euler collapse
Factor n to break it - infeasible at 2048 bits
